tasks.label: Generate and Open Allure Report
tasks.command: npx allure generate ./allure-results -o allure-report; npx allure open allure-report

tasks.label: Clean Allure Results
tasks.command: if (Test-Path allure-report/history) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path allure-results/history | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force allure-report/history/* allure-results/history/ }; Get-ChildItem allure-results -Exclude history -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0
